overview: A social enterprise platform connecting Kampot Heritage artisanal soap champions (formerly homeless individuals) with hotels and B2B customers in Cambodia, with trilingual support and community impact tracking.
features: Champion onboarding with photo upload and referral codes
Staff portal for approvals, consignment, and bi-weekly payouts
Hotel ordering with three-path champion selection and KHQR checkout
Public impact dashboard showing live community earnings in Riel
Trilingual interface in English, Khmer, and French
Champion portal with QR code sharing and pay-it-forward tracking
